data.name: Adham
data.gender_notes: Adham is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The first man created by Allah. The name Adham carries the meaning “Man, Adam” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Adham usually hope their child will grow to embody man, adam and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the beginning of creation and the human quest for truth and righteousness
data.etymology: Adham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man, Adam.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adham total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Adham holds great significance in Islamic culture as it represents the first man ever created by Allah SWT in this world. According to Islamic belief, Prophet Adam عليه السلام (peace be upon him) was the first human being who was created and honored as the Caliph (Khalifah) or vicegerent of Allah on earth. This signifies his unique position in Islamic history and the importance of his role in shaping human civilization.
data.spiritual_significance: The significance of the name Adham from a spiritual perspective is rooted in the Islamic belief that Prophet Adam is the father of all humanity. As the first human being, he was created with a special Divine favor and blessings from Allah SWT. The story of Prophet Adam in Islamic tradition teaches valuable lessons about human nature, repentance, and the importance of seeking Allah's forgiveness. His experience of disobedience, remorse, and ultimate acceptance of Allah's mercy serves as a reminder for all Muslims to strive for the pleasure of Allah and to seek His forgiveness at all times.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Man, Adam" symbolizes The first man created by Allah. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Adham serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of man, adam.
